title: Charney Companies
summary: A website for a vertically integrated real estate organization: development, brokerage and management.
challenge: Charney had a new brand. The old site did not carry that identity, or the features the business needed.
solution: We redesigned and built the website from the brandbook: voice, type, color, grid, photography, and a clearer path through the three pillars.

about.title: About
about.body: The Charney Companies is a vertically integrated real estate organization, made of three pillars: Development, Brokerage and Management. Where cultivation meets innovation: respect for the craft, aesthetic ambition, and a contemporary take on equity in housing.

process.title: Objective, process &
process.body: Charney went through a brand redesign, so the website had to reflect it: value, personality, voice, type, color, grid, photography, texture, iconography. Plus requested features and improvements over the old site. The process: guidelines, wireframe, layout, styleguide, prototype and handoff.
